 Weather 
 Today's forecast 
 Get the latest weather updates from the NBC6 meteorologists. 
 By Adam Berg • 
 Published October 28, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 28, 2026 at 7:02 am 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 NBC6’s Adam Berg has your forecast for today, Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026.
 While we are just past the peak of this particular King Tide cycle, we are still expected moderate to major flooding around high tide, especially in low-lying areas near the coast. 
 With that said, we are dialing back the rain and wind considerably. We have lost our wind advisory and gale warning. With less rain and more sun, temperatures will bounce a bit. Look for highs in well into the mid-80s. We are looking at a similar forecast through the end of the week.
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 Halloween weekend may bring more showers and storm our way. It doesn't look like a washout for the ghouls and goblins, but something we will monitor.
 TODAY : Partly cloudy with a lingering beach breeze, especially this afternoon. Rain: 30%. High: 86°.
 THURSDAY : Mostly sunny. A few storms. Rain: 30%. High: 87°.
 FRIDAY : Mostly sunny. A few storms. Rain: 30%. High: 87°.
